prof_intro: Hello! I am Professor Maple Hollis.
Willow Town is where I study Jakamon, the creatures who share our days.
Long ago Sol, Eater of Food, kept our sun bright and our tables full.
Team Eclipse wants that light for themselves. They hid five Sun Shards in the wild places.
If the shards go quiet, so does the day. I need a partner with a kind heart.
First, let me see who is setting out.
prof_idle: The forest road is open. The other gates wake when a shard is safe.
Kai left in a hurry. Rivalry keeps them honest, I think.
nurse: Your Jakamon look tired. May I restore them?
clerk: Maple Market! Twine Balls, balm, and rope.
What can I pass across the counter?
town_child: I saw a white-haired trainer run toward the trees.
They said they would be famous by lunch.
town_elder: The Hearth's sun mark is older than the market.
Sol liked this town because someone always shared a meal.
cave_swamp: A stone stair climbs out of the mud.
sol_wait: The shards hum in a circle.
Sol is here, if you are ready to meet the sun.
sol_after: Willow Town's kitchens will be busy tonight.
credits: Professor Maple Hollis believes in shared tables.
Kai will race you again tomorrow.
Team Eclipse has gone home to think.
Thank you for keeping the sun fed.
Art of the Jakamon belongs to their keeper.
